basic_info.description: This beautifully updated 2-bedroom home blends the best of city living with a neighborhood feel, nestled in the heart of desirable Glen Park. Though a condo on paper, this truly lives like a single-family home, comprising the entire front, freestanding building. The main level features a large living room with tiled fireplace and bay windows, a separate dining area, and refreshed kitchen with new floors, quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, and access to a private, outdoor deck. The deck is south-facing and the perfect spot for lounging and barbecuing. Upstairs you will find two, light-filled, high-ceiling bedrooms and a full bathroom. The rear bedroom features floor to ceiling windows with expansive southern views, extensive closet storage, and a desk nook for flex use as an office space. The front bedroom is generously sized with light filtering + blackout shades, and can easily accommodate a king-sized bed. The entry level offers a convenient pantry or storage closet and interior access to the garage and laundry area. Arlington Street is a slow street, meaning minimal traffic outside your front door. Short walk to Glen Park Village, BART, and the beautiful Glen Canyon Park.  Easy commute with entrances to I-280 & 101 within minutes. More details: www.353arlington.com
